disk.description: Disk holding the system region and VAR.

model.description: Glob the disk's model matches, such as `Samsung SSD 870*`.

path.description: Path of the disk below /dev, such as /dev/disk/by-id/…; excludes the selector keys.

size.description: Comparison the disk's size meets, such as `>= 1T`; the size has at most 18 digits without a suffix, and 15, 12, 9, 6 or 3 with K, M, G, T or P.

fallback.description: Second keyslot asked for on the console when TPM2 unsealing fails.

mode.description: Encryption of STATE, VAR and volumes: `tpm2` seals a LUKS2 key to PCR 7, `none` uses no encryption.
Overrides the node's encryption mode for VAR.

size.description: Size of VAR, such as `20G`, with at most 18 digits without a suffix, and 15, 12, 9, 6 or 3 with K, M, G, T or P; null fills the remaining space on the system disk.
